title: Roasted Tomato, Mozzarella and Pesto Calzones
changes_from_base: Slow-roasted peeled tomatoes with garlic, a thin layer of basil pesto and plenty of low-moisture mozzarella fill six calzones made with a sweetened yeast dough, replacing the spinach and ricotta.
summary: Six savoury baked pastries encasing sweet, concentrated roasted tomatoes, fresh mozzarella and aromatic basil pesto.
equipment: stand mixer with dough hook or large bowl and wooden spoon

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt
large egg, beaten with 1 tsp water

steps.title: Start dough
steps.text: Mix the warm water with caster sugar, sprinkle the dried yeast on top and leave undisturbed for 5 min until the surface turns foamy.

steps.title: Make dough
steps.text: Add the plain flour, salt and olive oil to the yeast liquid and mix on low speed until everything comes together, then on medium speed until you have a smooth ball of dough.

steps.title: First rise
steps.text: Cover and leave somewhere warm for about 1 hour until roughly doubled in size.

steps.title: Roast tomatoes
steps.text: While the dough rises, heat the oven to 150 °C, place the halved tomatoes cut side down on a rimmed baking tray, drizzle with olive oil, scatter with garlic slivers and season with salt, roast for 40–45 min until the skins wrinkle and the tomatoes have shrunk, cool slightly, slip off and discard the papery skins.

steps.title: Drain
steps.text: Put the skinned tomatoes and garlic in a sieve and let them drain (discard the juice that collects).

steps.title: Divide
steps.text: Turn the risen dough onto an unfloured surface, cut it into 6 roughly equal pieces of about 120 g each and roll each under a cupped hand into a tight ball.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Cover and leave for 15 min (or chill overnight under oiled cling film and bring back to room temperature before continuing).

steps.title: Prepare oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 260 °C with the pizza stone on the lowest shelf inside (or brush a large rimmed tray with oil).

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Roll each ball to a 20 cm circle, spread 1½ tbsp of the basil pesto thinly over it leaving a 2–3 cm border, pile a sixth of the mozzarella onto one half and top with a sixth of the roasted tomatoes, fold over the dough and then roll and crimp the edges firmly to seal.

steps.title: Brush
steps.text: Brush each calzone with the beaten egg and water mixture and sprinkle with flaky sea salt.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Using a large spatula, move them onto the hot stone or tray, positioning at an angle to fit all three, and bake for 18–23 min until puffed up and deep brown, covering loosely with foil if the tops are darkening too quickly, cool for 5 min before serving.

tips: Slip the tomato skins off after roasting them while they are still warm—they come away far more easily than when cold.
Spread the pesto thinly so it doesn't make the dough soggy; a thinner layer gives better flavour distribution anyway.
Watch the oven closely after 20 min; if the pastry browns quickly, cover loosely with foil to prevent burning whilst the interior finishes cooking.
storage: Serve warm. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
